https://atid.store.core_purpose: The site provides an online e-commerce platform for users to browse, purchase, and manage orders for a variety of retail products.
business_requirements: Users must be able to browse and filter products by categories, price range, and other attributes.
Users must be able to add multiple products to a shopping cart and view the total cost before proceeding to checkout.
Users must be able to securely enter payment and shipping information to complete purchases.
Users must be able to create and manage personal accounts to track order history and save preferences.
Users must receive confirmation emails upon successful orders, including order details and estimated delivery timelines.
Administrators must be able to update product listings, inventory levels, and pricing in real-time.
The platform must ensure responsive design to allow seamless usage across desktops, tablets, and mobile devices.
